integrity: The universal spectrum formula is proved analytically from the structure of independent sets and color-dominating vertices in crown graphs. Exhaustive partition enumeration for n from 3 through 5 is used only as a finite stress test.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only crown graphs and the constant two-CDV sequence. It does not classify other sequences or arbitrary bipartite graphs. An equivalent result under terminology not surfaced by the inspected literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Two-point sequence \(b\)-spectrum of crown graphs
